title: Customer Data Platform
tagline: One customer profile, built from every touchpoint.
overview: A CDP pulls behavioral, transactional and demographic data from every system you run — POS, CMS, ESP, CRM — into one real customer profile, instead of eight partial ones that disagree with each other.
features: API access for downstream marketing tools

process.title: Data Source Audit
process.desc: We map every system holding customer data before designing how they'll unify.

process.title: Identity Resolution Setup
process.desc: Matching rules are configured so the same customer is recognized across every channel.

process.title: Segment & Consent Configuration
process.desc: Audience segments and consent rules are set up in line with your compliance requirements.

process.title: Activation & Monitoring
process.desc: Unified profiles are activated into your marketing tools, with ongoing accuracy monitoring.

benefits.title: Personalization that actually works
benefits.desc: Campaigns run on a complete customer picture instead of a fragment of their activity.

benefits.title: No more conflicting customer records
benefits.desc: One profile per customer replaces the slightly-different version each tool used to hold.

benefits.title: Faster audience segmentation
benefits.desc: Marketing builds segments in minutes instead of requesting a data pull from engineering.

faqs.q: Does a CDP replace our CRM?
faqs.a: No — it feeds your CRM (and other tools) a unified profile; the CRM still owns sales relationship management.

faqs.q: How is customer consent handled?
faqs.a: Consent status is tracked per customer and per channel, and downstream tools respect it automatically rather than relying on manual list management.

faqs.q: Can it unify data from systems we already use?
faqs.a: Yes, that's the core function — connecting your existing POS, CMS, ESP and CRM data into one profile.

testimonial.quote: We stopped arguing about whose customer count was 'right' — there's just one number now, and everyone trusts it.
testimonial.author: Client Name
